title: Simultaneous Neural Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.37424v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for learning transformations between probability distributions from unpaired samples. In many applications, however, a single transformation must map several source distributions to a common target distribution. For example, image restoration might require handling different types of degradation without knowing the degradation of each input at inference time. Simple approaches of pooling the source distributions only encourage alignment with the target at the aggregate level and may leave individual sources misaligned. In our paper, we consider the simultaneous OT problem which formalizes the task of learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. translated_abstract: 最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）为从非配对样本中学习概率分布之间的变换提供了一个有原则的框架。然而在许多应用中，一个单一的变换需要将多个源分布映射到一个共同的目标分布。例如，图像修复可能需要在推理时不知道每个输入退化类型的情况下处理不同类型的退化。简单地将源分布合并的方法只会促使在总体层面上与目标对齐，可能导致个别源分布未能对齐。在本文中，我们考虑同步最优传输问题，该问题形式化了学习一个共享传输映射的任务，该映射在最小化平均传输成本的同时，将每个源分布与指定的目标对齐。我们提出了一种神经方法来求解同步最优传输问题，通过学习一个最小化平均传输成本的共享传输映射（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种神经方法来求解同步最优传输问题，通过学习单一的共享传输映射，在最小化平均传输成本的同时将多个源分布与指定目标分布对齐，从而克服了简单合并源分布导致个别源分布无法对齐的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a neural method for solving the simultaneous optimal transport problem, learning a single shared transport map that minimizes average transport cost while aligning multiple source distributions to a prescribed target, overcoming the misalignment issues of naive source-pooling approaches.
